properties.title: Integuru

overview_description.description: Integuru provides an API generation platform that converts websites and web systems into production-ready HTTP APIs. The service analyzes network requests of target platforms to reverse-engineer their underlying backend structure and generate direct HTTP integrations, without relying on browser automation or traditional RPA. It handles authentication flows, including cookies and multi-factor verification, and produces complete API schemas with documentation for requests and responses. Integuru also manages edge cases, branching logic, and auto-healing to keep integrations operational as target systems change. The platform supports self-serve usage with tiered plans and add-ons for higher volumes, and is used across sectors such as healthcare, logistics, finance, real estate, legal, government, and AI agents. Customers use Integuru to build read and write workflows that integrate with existing tools and portals.
